title: Croatian Bible 'Sveta Biblija' (eBible id hrv), full Bible, one verse per line
notes: License: 'public-domain' is stated for translation id 'hrv' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/hrv/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 3,863,364 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'croatian') gives 3,587,049 characters.
